title: Evaluation of STEM students' critical thinking in terms of cognitive style through problem-based distance learning
reason: One-group pre/post critical-thinking tests in problem-based distance learning, compared across field-dependent/independent cognitive style. CT tests are achievement measures; no LMS indicator or activity product is related to success or to cognitive style.

extraction.country: Indonesia (eastern Indonesia; Mandalika University of Education ethics approval)
extraction.design: evaluative one-group pre-post (Kirkpatrick), ANOVA by cognitive style
extraction.n_quote: the sample size of 28 STEM students from a single university in eastern Indonesia may not be representative
extraction.outcome_or_construct: critical-thinking test scores; cognitive style (field-dependent/independent, test-based)
extraction.notes: Cognitive style did not differ on CT: post-test 'F = 0.153, p = 0.699, η² = 0.006'; this is construct ↔ achievement, not an LMS/activity indicator.
